name: Plane
description:
Plane is an AI-native project management platform that unifies Projects, Wiki, and work tracking in one workspace. This official connector, maintained by Plane, lets Claude work directly inside your Plane workspace through the Model Context Protocol.

Once connected, Claude can create and update work items, triage your backlog, plan and manage cycles (sprints) and modules, organize epics, initiatives and milestones, move issues through workflow states, apply labels, log time, add comments, and read or write wiki and project pages — all in natural language.

Typical uses:
• Turn a meeting summary into structured work items
• Triage and re-prioritize incoming issues
• Summarize a cycle's progress, blockers and scope changes
• Draft a project plan as work items, epics and cycles
• Query project status across your workspace in plain English

The connector exposes 20+ tools spanning projects, work items, cycles, modules, epics, initiatives, milestones, states, labels, comments, worklogs, intake and pages. It authenticates with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE); you authorize with your Plane account and Claude acts within your existing workspace permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Plane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Plane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.plane.so/http/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Plane MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plane lists 28 MCP tools, including customer, customer_property, customer_request, cycle, get_pql_reference, initiative, intake, label, member, milestone, module, and page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Plane?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Plane in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Plane requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Plane is developed by Plane Software, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
